compensation._note: Feeders averaging at or above min_average_hours but below their committed hours fall under the compensation framework. Below the floor, the 7-Day Rule downgrade applies instead.

downgrade_exemptions._note: Feb-Mar 2026: Band A feeders under 18h were not downgraded and received special compensation. Confirm exact dates against the NERC order.
